assumptions: Express `res.on('close')` is used to detect client disconnect (the recipe confirms Node's http.ServerResponse emits 'close' instead of exposing an AbortSignal, and suggests an AbortController bridge). Downstream service is stubbed with a cancellable timer since no real URL exists. The DbPool Layer uses an in-memory record as the fake database. Cause.findErrorOption is cast to the union of typed errors; in a real app a Schema or exhaustive match would be cleaner. SIGTERM is the only signal handled; SIGINT could be added identically.
